18851-gibbon.title: Gibbon
18851-gibbon.creator: James Cotter Morison, M.A.
18851-gibbon.description: A book by James Cotter Morison, M.A.. at some pains in his Memoirs to show the length and quality of his pedigree, which he traces back to the times of the Second and Third Edwards. Noting the fact, we pass on to a nearer ancestor, his grandfather, who seems to have been a person of considerable energy of character and business talent.

arxiv-2003-08842.title: The higher structure of unstable homotopy groups
arxiv-2003-08842.creator: Samik Basu, David Blanc, and Debasis Sen
arxiv-2003-08842.description: Abstract . We construct certain unstable higher order homotopy operations indexed by the simplex categories of 𝚫 n \mathbf{\Delta}^{n} for n ≥ 2 n\geq 2 , and prove that all elements in the homotopy groups of a wedge of spheres are generated under such operations by Whitehead products and the group structure.

arxiv-2005-05937.title: Unexpectedly large electron correlation measured in Auger spectra of ferromagnetic iron thin films: orbital-selected Coulomb and exchange contributions
arxiv-2005-05937.creator: R. Gotter, A. Verna, M. Sbroscia, R. Moroni, F. Bisio, S. Iacobucci, F. Offi, S. R. Vaidya, A. Ruocco, G. Stefani
arxiv-2005-05937.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by R. Gotter, A. Verna, M. Sbroscia, R. Moroni, F. Bisio, S. Iacobucci, F. Offi, S. R. Vaidya, A. Ruocco, G. Stefani. A set of electron-correlation energies as large as 10 eV have been measured for a magnetic 2ML Fe film deposited on Ag(001).

arxiv-2302-13398.title: Recursive Nearest Neighbor Co-Kriging Models for Big Multi-fidelity Spatial Data Sets
arxiv-2302-13398.creator: Si Cheng, Bledar A. Konomi, Georgios Karagiannis, Emily L. Kang
arxiv-2302-13398.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Si Cheng, Bledar A. Konomi, Georgios Karagiannis, Emily L. Kang. Big datasets are gathered daily from different remote sensing platforms. Recently, statistical co-kriging models, with the help of scalable techniques, have been able to combine such datasets by using spatially varying bias corrections. The associated Bayesian inference for these models is usually facilitated via Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods which present (sometimes prohibitively) slow mixing and convergence because they require the simulation of high-dimensional random effect vectors from their posteriors given large datasets.

arxiv-2305-13461.title: A NOTE ON TRANSCENDENTAL ANALYTIC FUNCTIONS WITH RATIONAL COEFFICIENTS MAPPING ℚ \mathbb{Q} INTO ITSELF
arxiv-2305-13461.creator: JEAN LELIS, DIEGO MARQUES*, CARLOS GUSTAVO MOREIRA, PAVEL TROJOVSKÝ
arxiv-2305-13461.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by JEAN LELIS, DIEGO MARQUES*, CARLOS GUSTAVO MOREIRA, PAVEL TROJOVSKÝ. In this note, the main focus is on a question about transcendental entire functions mapping ℚ \mathbb{Q} into ℚ \mathbb{Q} (which is related to a Mahler’s problem).

arxiv-2501-04207.title: A determinant formula for Toeplitz operators associated to a minimal flow
arxiv-2501-04207.creator: Efton Park
arxiv-2501-04207.description: Abstract . We define a determinant on the Toeplitz algebra associated to a minimal flow, give a formula for this determinant in terms of symbols, and show that this determinant can be used to give information about the algebraic K K -theory of functions on the underlying space. Let A be an n\times n matrix with complex entries.

arxiv-2504-02194.title: FairDAG: Consensus Fairness over Multi-Proposer Causal Design
arxiv-2504-02194.creator: Dakai Kang, Junchao Chen, Tien Tuan Anh Dinh † , Mohammad Sadoghi
arxiv-2504-02194.description: Abstract . The rise of cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum has driven interest in blockchain database technology, with smart contracts enabling the growth of decentralized finance (DeFi). However, research has shown that adversaries exploit transaction ordering to extract profits through attacks like front-running, sandwich attacks, and liquidation manipulation.

arxiv-2504-09803.title: CUT: Pruning Pre-Trained Multi-Task Models into Compact Models for Edge Devices
arxiv-2504-09803.creator: Jingxuan Zhou, Weidong Bao✉, Ji Wang, Zhengyi Zhong
arxiv-2504-09803.description: Abstract Multi-task learning has garnered widespread attention in the industry due to its efficient data utilization and strong generalization capabilities, making it particularly suitable for providing high-quality intelligent services to users. Edge devices, as the primary platforms directly serving users, play a crucial role in delivering multi-task services.

arxiv-2509-15843.title: Tsururu: A Python-based Time Series Forecasting Strategies Library
arxiv-2509-15843.creator: Alina Kostromina, Kseniia Kuvshinova, Aleksandr Yugay, Andrey Savchenko, Dmitry Simakov
arxiv-2509-15843.description: Abstract While current time series research focuses on developing new models, crucial questions of selecting an optimal approach for training such models are underexplored. Tsururu, a Python library introduced in this paper, bridges SoTA research and industry by enabling flexible combinations of global and multivariate approaches and multi-step-ahead forecasting strategies. It also enables seamless integration with various forecasting models.

arxiv-2512-16406.title: Hypernetworks That Evolve Themselves
arxiv-2512-16406.creator: Joachim Winther Pedersen, Erwan Plantec, Eleni Nisioti, Marcello Barylli, Milton Montero, Kathrin Korte, and Sebastian Risi
arxiv-2512-16406.description: Abstract How can neural networks evolve themselves without relying on external optimizers? We propose Self-Referential Graph HyperNetworks , systems where the very machinery of variation and inheritance is embedded within the network. By uniting hypernetworks, stochastic parameter generation, and graph-based representations, Self-Referential GHNs mutate and evaluate themselves while adapting mutation rates as selectable traits.

Here, we assess the effect of SARS-CoV-2 variants B.1.1.7 (Alpha), B.1.351 (Beta), P.1 (Gamma),...

plos-pone-0006182.title: Drosophila RISC Component VIG and Its Homolog Vig2 Impact Heterochromatin Formation
plos-pone-0006182.creator: Elena Gracheva, Monica Dus, Sarah C. R. Elgin
plos-pone-0006182.description: PLOS ONE research article. Heterochromatin formation plays an important role in gene regulation and the maintenance of genome integrity. Here we present results from a study of the D. melanogaster gene vig , encoding an RNAi complex component and its homolog vig2 ( CG11844 ) that support their involvement

pmc-11283506.title: Targeted delivery of bee venom to A549 lung cancer cells by PEGylate liposomal formulation: an apoptotic investigation
pmc-11283506.creator: Samireh Badivi, Sara Kazemi, Mohammadmahdi Eskandarisani, Nastaran Asghari Moghaddam, Ghazal Mesbahian, Sara Karimifard, Elham Afzali
pmc-11283506.description: This study focused on developing an optimal formulation of liposomes loaded with bee venom (BV) and coated with PEG (BV-Lipo-PEG). The liposomes were characterized using dynamic light scattering, transmission electron microscopy, and Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy. Among the liposomal formulations, F3 exhibited the narrowest size distribution with a low PDI value of 193.72 ± 7.

pmc-11296337.title: Lunar soil record of atmosphere loss over eons
pmc-11296337.creator: Nicole X. Nie, Nicolas Dauphas, Zhe J. Zhang, Timo Hopp, Menelaos Sarantos
pmc-11296337.description: The Moon has a tenuous atmosphere produced by space weathering. The short-lived nature of the atoms surrounding the Moon necessitates continuous replenishment from lunar regolith through mechanisms such as micrometeorite impacts, ion sputtering, and photon-stimulated desorption. Despite advances, previous remote sensing and space mission data have not conclusively disentangled the contributions of these processes.

pmc-11416461.title: Vaginal botryoid rhabdomyosarcoma in an infant: A case report and review of the literature
pmc-11416461.creator: Sara Essetti, Chaymae Faraj, Ihssane Lahlou, Fatima Chait, Nourrelhouda Bahlouli, Nazik Allali, Siham El Haddad, Latifa Chat
pmc-11416461.description: Botryoid rhabdomyosarcoma is a rare and aggressive malignancy that primarily affects the female genital tract in children. It arises from embryonal rhabdomyoblasts. The vagina is the most common site, but it can also occur, although rarely, in the cervix or uterine fundus.

pmc-11522681.title: Breath-hold capacities and circadian dive rhythmicity shape optimal foraging strategies in a polar marine mammal, the Weddell seal (Leptonychotes weddellii)
pmc-11522681.creator: Michelle R Shero, Daniel P Costa, Jennifer M Burns, Kimberly T Goetz
pmc-11522681.description: Air-breathing vertebrates must balance their response to diel shifts in prey accessibility with physiological thresholds and the need to surface after each dive. Weddell seal (Leptonychotes weddellii) dive behaviors were tracked across the year under rapidly-changing light regimes in the Ross Sea, Antarctica ( ~ 75-77°S).

pmc-11666820.title: Hypnea musciformis Seaweed Extract Protected Human Mesenchymal Stem Cells From Oxidative Stress Through NRF2 Activation
pmc-11666820.creator: Andreas Goutas, Nikolaos Goutzourelas, Alkistis Kevrekidou, Dimitrios Phaedon Kevrekidis, Paraskevi Malea, Christina Virgiliou, Andreana N Assimopoulou, Varvara Trachana, Nikolaos Kollatos, Tafa Moustafa, Ming Liu, Xiukun Lin, Dimitrios Komiotis, Dimitrios Stagos
pmc-11666820.description: Previous studies have shown that Hypnea musciformis seaweed extracts (HMEs) possess antioxidant properties, but the molecular mechanisms accounting for this activity are not known. Thus, the present study investigated the molecular mechanisms through which HME exerted its antioxidant activity in human mesenchymal stem cells (WJ‐MSCs).

pmc-11692265.title: REDEFINING SUCCESSFUL AGING: INTEGRATING DISABILITY AND THE ROLE OF MODIFIABLE FACTORS
pmc-11692265.creator: Madina Khamzina, Shannon Mejia, Wendy Rogers
pmc-11692265.description: Disability is a common experience in older adulthood, yet traditional models often neglect its role in successful aging. This study integrates disability into the successful aging framework, utilizing subjective well-being and self-rated health as key indicators. We aim to link disability and successful aging and examine modifiable factors that could foster successful aging among individuals with disabilities over time.

pmc-11747299.title: Protocol for the systematic review of age and sex in preclinical models of age-correlated diseases
pmc-11747299.creator: Kai Diederich, Matthias Steinfath, Alexandra Bannach-Brown, Bettina Bert, Daniel Butzke, Paul Lucas Wildner, Maximilian Wurm, Ines Schadock, Céline Heinl, Alberto Granzotto, Devin Wahl, Devin Wahl, Kai Diederich
pmc-11747299.description: The translation of animal-based biomedical research into clinical research is often inadequate. Maximizing translation should be central to animal research on human diseases, guiding researchers in study design and animal model selection. However, practical considerations often drive the choice of animal model, which may not always reflect key patient characteristics, such as sex and age, impacting the disease's course.

pmc-13084266.title: Five new synonyms in Impatiens (Ericales, Balsaminaceae) from China
pmc-13084266.creator: Fang-Ying Wang, Nian Cen, Xin-Xiang Bai, Qin-Qin Yong, Mei-Jun Li
pmc-13084266.description: Species of Impatiens L. on the Yunnan–Guizhou Plateau show exceptionally high diversity, but inadequate early regional surveys have led to persistent taxonomic ambiguity. Critical study of the type and additional specimens, supported by field observations and comparative morphology, demonstrates that: (1) Impatiens lepida Hook.f. is conspecific with Impatiens piufanensis Hook.f.; (2) Impatiens sigmoidea Hook.f. and Impatiens martinii Hook.f.

pmc-13357915.title: Harmonization of slice thickness through resampling improves comparability of MRI-derived neonatal brain volumes
pmc-13357915.creator: Anouk S. Verschuur, Martijn F. Boomsma, Alexander Leemans, Ingrid M. Nijholt, Leonora Hendson, Selma Low, Amy Metcalfe, Donna M. Slater, Chantal M. W. Tax, Gerda Meijler, Lara M. Leijser
pmc-13357915.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeTo assess reliability and agreement of brain volume measurements from neonatal T2-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans acquired with different slice thickness settings (i.e., 2 mm, 3 mm and 3 mm resampled).MethodsWe used term-equivalent (38–45 weeks postmenstrual age) T2-weighted MRI scans with slice thicknesses of 2 mm and 3 mm from a subset of 40 preterm and term infants (27–40 weeks' gestation) from two existing neonatal imaging cohorts.

pmc-13565945.title: Real-World Clinical Outcomes of Manual Versus Powered Endoscopic Staplers in Minimally Invasive Lung Cancer Surgery
pmc-13565945.creator: Cosimo Lequaglie, Gabriella Giudice, Annalisa Carlucci, Roberto Cascone
pmc-13565945.description: Objectives: Manual surgical staplers remain widely used in minimally invasive lung surgery, while powered devices have been introduced to improve tissue compression, staple formation, and device handling. This study compared clinical outcomes associated with manual and powered endoscopic staplers in patients undergoing minimally invasive lung cancer surgery, with postoperative air leak as the main outcome of interest.

pmc-13675743.title: Chromoblastomycosis in Timor-Leste: Highlighting an underdiagnosed condition
pmc-13675743.creator: Terlinda da C. Barros, Amadeu R.X.A. Mendes, Dulce MC. Alberto, Manmeet Kaur, Tessa Oakley, Marlous L. Grijsen
pmc-13675743.description: Chromoblastomycosis is a chronic implantation mycosis caused by dematiaceous fungi, primarily affecting agricultural workers in impoverished (sub)tropical regions. It often causes disfiguring lesions on the lower limbs, leading to stigma, and reduced quality of life. Treatment is prolonged and challenging.
